questions.reference: A modification is binding only if it is in writing and signed by an authorized representative of both parties, whereas notices must be in writing and delivered via electronic mail, registered, or certified mail to the address in the signature block.

evidence.quote: No change or addition to any provision shall be binding unless it is in writing and signed by an authorized representative of both parties.
All notices shall be in writing and delivered by electronic mail, registered or certified mail (return receipt requested) to the appropriate address set forth in the signature block below.

questions.question: Under what specific condition does the Recipient's obligation to keep information confidential cease to apply if that information enters the public domain?

any information which is or in future comes into the public domain (unless as a result of the breach of this Agreement); or

questions.question: survive indefinitely return copies

evidence.quote: The Recipient will, on request from the Discloser, return all copies and records of the Confidential Information to the Discloser and will not retain any copies or records of the Confidential Information.
The undertakings in clauses 2 and 3 will continue in force indefinitely.

questions.question: Who has to give written approval before I can share the info, and what is the minimum standard of care I must use to protect it?
questions.reference: The Disclosing Party must give approval, and I must use at least a reasonable degree of care.

evidence.quote: the Receiving Party shall not disclose Confidential Information to any third party without the prior written approval of the Disclosing Party.

The Receiving Party shall maintain the Confidential Information with at least the same degree of care that the Receiving Party uses to protect its own similar categories of confidential and proprietary information, but no less than a reasonable degree of care under the circumstances.

questions.question: Under which jurisdiction's laws is the agreement governed, and what is the required form for any amendments?

questions.question: Does the Recipient's obligation to maintain confidentiality extend to Confidential Information provided verbally, given that the Purpose is limited to the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a CCTV System?

Recipient agrees not to disclose and the Discloser agrees to let the Recipient have the access to the Confidential Information as identified and reduced in writing or provided verbally or in any other way not reduced in writing at the time of such disclosure of the information.

questions.question: If I create a new report using the confidential info, do I own the copyright to it?

evidence.quote: all intellectual property, patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret and all other rights and interests in the Confidential Information and the products, inventions, ideas, works, creation, symbols, data, reports, opinions and all other concepts and materials developed, invented, reduced to practice, authored or created by Receiver (including portions and derivatives thereof) in any medium arising from or relating to this Agreement (“Intellectual Property”) shall be the sole and exclusive property of VIDAR.

questions.question: Does the definition of Confidential Information explicitly cover information supplied to me regarding clients, given that I have agreed to keep such information strictly confidential?
questions.reference: Yes, because the definition includes any information relating to clients disclosed by any means, and you have agreed to keep all such client-related information strictly confidential.

evidence.quote: I fully understand and agree that all information relating to any client of The Business Partnership and supplied to me will be kept strictly confidential.
Confidential Information shall mean any information or data relating to any clients of The Business Partnership business or affairs disclosed whether in writing, orally or by any other means.

questions.question: Who is the designated intermediary through whom all offers and approaches must be directed to avoid direct contact with the Owner?

To submit any offer for the purchase of the Business and/or property directly through the Agents TBP and not directly to the Owner.

questions.reference: No, you cannot use it for your own projects because you are only allowed to use it for the specific Purpose, even if you keep it secret.

questions.question: Which specific courts are designated to have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, and under whose laws is the agreement governed?
questions.reference: The courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction, and the agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

evidence.quote: This Agreement and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.

Each Party irrevocable agrees that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with this Agreement or its subject matter or formation.

questions.question: Does the Receiving Party acquire any intellectual property rights from the NDA, and what are the specific procedural requirements for returning Confidential Information upon termination?
questions.reference: The Receiving Party acquires no rights in patents, trademarks, or know-how; upon a 30-day written request, they must return all Confidential Information and copies, and provide written confirmation that computerized forms have been destroyed.

evidence.quote: The Receiving Party shall under no circumstances obtain any right in the Disclosing Party's patents, trademark or know-how by reason of the NDA.

Either Party shall, upon 30 days written request by the other Party, return to the other party all Confidential Information which the latter has disclosed to the former, together with all copies or reproductions thereof together with a confirmation in writing that the Confidential Information in computerized form has been destroyed.

questions.question: Does the definition of Personnel include the Disclosing Party's professional advisors?

questions.question: To whom must all communications regarding the Parties' discussions be directed, and what is the specific restriction on disclosing the fact that such discussions are taking place?
questions.reference: Communications must be directed to authorised representatives of the Parties, and the Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that discussions are taking place without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent.

evidence.quote:
Save as otherwise permitted herein, a Receiving Party shall not, and shall procure that its Personnel do not, at any time without the Disclosing Party’s prior written consent:
(a) disclose the Conﬁdential Information to any third party, either directly or indirectly; or
(b) disclose to any person: -
(i) the fact that discussions or negotiations are taking place between the Parties;
(ii) the content of any such discussions or negotiations;
(iii) any of the terms, conditions or other facts with respect to the Purpose; or
(iv) that Conﬁdential Information has been requested or received, unless required to do so by law or by the order or ruling of a Court or tribunal or regulatory body or recognised stock exchange of competent jurisdiction, in which case, if the Receiving Party is required to disclose such Conﬁdential Information it shall, unless prohibited from doing so, notify the Disclosing Party promptly in writing of that fact and, in any event, prior to making such disclosure.

It is understood that all communications regarding the Parties’ discussions, requests for additional information or meetings or questions will be submitted or directed to authorised representatives of the Parties.

questions.question: Does the agreement provide that a fax notice sent on a Friday after 18:00 hours is deemed received on the next Business Day, and does it simultaneously grant the English courts exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes?
questions.reference: Yes, the agreement deems such a fax received on the next Business Day and grants the English courts exclusive jurisdiction.

The Parties irrevocably agree that the English courts shall have the exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

questions.question: can I transfer this NDA to a partner without written consent
questions.reference: No, the agreement cannot be assigned without prior written consent, and any modification or waiver requires a written instrument executed by both parties.

evidence.quote: The provisions of this Agreement may not be modified, amended, nor waived, except by a written instrument duly executed by the Parties hereto.
This Agreement may not be assigned by either party without the prior written consent of the other.

questions.question: consent required for copying vs legal compulsion
questions.reference: Prior written consent of the DISCLOSING PARTY is required for copying, whereas the RECEIVING PARTY may disclose without consent if required by outside counsel opinion to avoid violating law

evidence.quote: Tangible forms of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION shall not be copied, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the DISCLOSING PARTY.

In the event the RECEIVING PARTY receives in writing an opinion from its outside counsel that it must disclose certain information, prohibited by the terms herein, in order to avoid committing a violation of law, the RECEIVING PARTY may disclose only that information necessary to avoid committing such violation of the law.

If, in the absence of a protective order or other remedy or the receipt of a waiver by the DISCLOSING PARTY, the RECEIVING PARTY is nonetheless, in the opinion of counsel, legally compelled to disclose CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION to any tribunal or else stand liable for contempt or suffer other censure or penalty, the RECEIVING PARTY may, without liability hereunder, disclose to such tribunal only that portion of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION which such counsel advises RECEIVING PARTY is legally required to be disclosed, provided that the RECEIVING PARTY will cooperate with the DISCLOSING PARTY in seeking to preserve the confidentiality of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION before such tribunal.

questions.question: If I am compelled to disclose Confidential Information to a tribunal, what specific notice and cooperation obligations do I have, and what portion of the information am I permitted to reveal?
questions.reference: You must provide prompt written notice to the Disclosing Party so they can seek a protective order, and you may only disclose the portion of the information that your counsel advises is legally required, while cooperating with the Disclosing Party to preserve confidentiality.

evidence.quote: the RECEIVING PARTY shall provide the DISCLOSING PARTY with prompt written notice of any such request or requirement so that the DISCLOSING PARTY may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy or waive compliance with the provisions of this Agreement.

the RECEIVING PARTY may, without liability hereunder, disclose to such tribunal only that portion of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION which such counsel advises RECEIVING PARTY is legally required to be disclosed, provided that the RECEIVING PARTY will cooperate with the DISCLOSING PARTY in seeking to preserve the confidentiality of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION before such tribunal.

questions.question: Under which jurisdiction's laws are the obligations governed, and what specific events trigger their expiration?
questions.reference: The obligations are governed by New York law and expire upon the earlier of the specified number of years after the last loan termination or the date the information ceases to be confidential.

evidence.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

The obligations hereunder shall expire upon the earlier to occur of (a) ___ years from the termination date of the last loan of securities outstanding under the Borrowing Agreement or (b) the date upon which the Information ceases to be confidential as set forth above.

questions.question: Who is considered a Representative of the Recipient Party, and how is the Disclosing Party defined in relation to the sharing of Confidential Information?
questions.reference: Representatives include employees, agents, officers, professional advisers, and Affiliates of the Recipient Party, while the Disclosing Party is any Party that discloses or makes available Confidential Information directly or indirectly.

evidence.quote: Disclosing Party: means a Party to this Agreement which discloses or makes available directly or indirectly Confidential Information.
Representative(s): means employees, agents, officers, professional advisers and Affiliates of the Recipient Party.

questions.question: If I need to share the confidential info with a third party for the project, what do I have to get from you first, and what happens to the data if you ask me to return it later?

evidence.quote: to return or destroy or if stored in electronic form to erase from its systems (to the extent possible) at its own expense the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party together with any copies in its possession or in the possession of its Representatives at the request of the Disclosing Party.

questions.question: Does the execution of this agreement serve as confirmation that the contractor has received the RFP and intends to submit a proposal, and if so, which specific RFP does this apply to?

questions.question: If State terminates the agreement with the required five days' notice, is the Recipient still subject to an injunction in Juneau without posting a bond for any subsequent breach?

“Confidential Information” means any information disclosed to the Contractor by the CAO or the House, including, but not limited to: (a) security practices, operational information, business plans, customer data, customer lists, customer names, designs, documents, drawings, engineering information, hardware configuration information, processes, products, product plans, research, services, specifications, software, source code and trade secrets; and (b) any other information designated (orally or in writing) as “confidential,” “proprietary” or of such nature that a reasonable person would understand such information to be confidential to the CAO or the House.

questions.question: What are the two specific written actions the Contractor must take regarding the State when dealing with non-employee agents or unauthorized disclosures?
questions.reference: Obtain written consent for dissemination to non-employee agents and promptly advise in writing of any unauthorized use or disclosure.

evidence.quote: If the Contractor intends to disseminate any portion of the Confidential Information to non-employee agents who are assisting in the Contractor’s performance of the Contract or will otherwise have a role in performing any aspect of the Contract, the Contractor shall first obtain the written consent of the State to any such dissemination.

The Contractor shall promptly advise the State in writing if it learns of any unauthorized use, misappropriation, or disclosure of the Confidential Information by any of the Contractor’s Personnel or the Contractor’s former Personnel.

questions.question: What is the minimum standard of protection required for the other party's confidential information?
questions.reference: At least as protective as the steps taken to protect our own confidential information

questions.question: Does the non-solicitation clause restrict the Partner from soliciting BCG's customers only if BCG introduced the Partner to them, while the employee non-solicitation restriction remains in effect for twelve months post-termination?

questions.question: How do the rebuttable presumptions for receipt differ between notices sent via prepaid registered post and those sent by telefacsimile during business hours?
questions.reference: Notices sent by prepaid registered post are presumed received on the fourth day after posting, whereas telefacsimiles sent during business hours are presumed received on the first business day succeeding transmission.

evidence.quote: Posted by prepaid registered post from an address within the Republic of South Africa to the addressee’s domicilium for the time being shall be rebuttably presumed to have been received by the recipient on the fourth day after the date of posting.

Any notice given by telefacsimile during the normal business hours of the address to the addressee’s domicilium for the time being shall be rebuttably presumed to have been received on the first business day succeeding the day on which the telefacsimile is transmitted.

questions.question: Does the agreement define the Receiving Party as a Bidder interested in the disposal of the Blue Train business?

questions.question: How do I properly mark information as confidential if I'm sharing it in writing versus if I'm just telling someone over the phone?

If Confidential Information is transmitted orally, the Disclosing Party shall promptly provide writing indicating that such oral communication constituted Confidential Information.

questions.question: When do I have to stop keeping the information secret, and what do I need to do with my notes if you ask for them back?
questions.reference: You must keep the information secret until it is no longer a trade secret or until you receive written notice releasing you from the agreement, whichever happens first. If the disclosing party requests it in writing, you must immediately return all records, notes, and tangible materials pertaining to the confidential information.

evidence.quote: Receiving Party shall return to Disclosing Party any and all records, notes, and other written, printed, or tangible materials in its possession pertaining to Confidential Information immediately if Disclosing Party requests it in writing.

Receiving Party's duty to hold Confidential Information in confidence shall remain in effect until the Confidential Information no longer qualifies as a trade secret or until Disclosing Party sends Receiving Party written notice releasing Receiving Party from this Agreement, whichever occurs first.

questions.question: Effective Date EoI issue date

questions.question: who is liable if other respondents leak info

questions.question: Does the agreement explicitly exclude third-party enforcement rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 while maintaining a seven-year term from the Effective Date?

evidence.quote: This Agreement shall come into force on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect, notwithstanding the completion of the Purpose, for a period of seven years from the Effective Date unless extended, superseded or otherwise varied by a subsequent written agreement between the Parties.
It is not intended that a third party (other than an ETI Affiliate) should have the right to enforce a provision of this Agreement pursuant to the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

questions.question: Which specific UK statute is expressly excluded from applying to the agreement, and what is the primary obligation regarding Confidential Information upon written request?
questions.reference: The Contracts (Right of Third Parties) Act 1999 is excluded, and the recipient must destroy all Confidential Information immediately upon written request.

evidence.quote: G) to destroy immediately on our written request all Confidential Information in your possession including any copies made (save where we are required pursuant to some law or enactment or regulation or the rules of any Stock Exchange to retain originals or copies of any of the Confidential Information).
J) that this agreement does not create any right enforceable by any person who is not a party to it and that the Contracts (Right of Third Parties) Act 1999 as amended shall not apply.

questions.question: If a dispute arises regarding the validity of a notice sent under this agreement, which jurisdiction's courts have exclusive authority to resolve it, and how is the timing of that notice's receipt legally defined for the purpose of establishing the dispute?
questions.reference: The courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction to settle the dispute, and the notice is deemed received on the second weekday (excluding Sundays or public/bank holidays in England) following the day it was posted.

evidence.quote: that this agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales and the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim that arises out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims)

that any notices under this agreement shall be sent by first-class prepaid post to the address of the recipient party as set out in this letter and shall be deemed to have been received on the second week day (that is, any day excluding Sundays or public or bank holidays in England) following the day on which it was posted.

questions.question: Under what regulatory purpose is the prospective applicant acting, and what are the specific conditions governing the data owner's obligation to share data with them?
questions.reference: The prospective applicant is acting for a purpose under the Biocidal Products Regulation 528/2012, and the data owner is obligated to share data in certain circumstances but may also choose to do so voluntarily regardless of that obligation.

evidence.quote: The prospective applicant is seeking to do so for a purpose under the Biocidal Products Regulation 528/2012 (“the BPR”);
